settingsResetTrainingHelp: Reset all training defaults for this WaveDL server? Existing drafts and runs will not change.
settingsResetDataHelp: Turn off stay signed in and restore the default navigation dock? Your current connection stays active, but it will no longer be remembered after you close the browser.
settingsResetAllHelp: Reset appearance, training defaults for this WaveDL server, the navigation dock and the “Stay signed in” preference in this browser? Existing drafts, datasets and runs will not change. Your current connection stays active.
settingsClearLocalHelp: Remove saved appearance, training defaults for this WaveDL server, the navigation dock and the “Stay signed in” preference from this browser? Defaults will apply immediately. Other WaveDL servers’ defaults, datasets and runs will not be deleted. Your current connection stays active.
